landmarks.name: Tower of London
landmarks.hint: A historic castle on the north bank of the Thames, once a royal palace and prison

landmarks.name: Buckingham Palace
landmarks.hint: The official London residence and administrative headquarters of the British monarch

landmarks.name: Big Ben
landmarks.hint: The iconic clock tower at the north end of the Palace of Westminster

landmarks.name: London Eye
landmarks.hint: A giant Ferris wheel on the South Bank of the River Thames

landmarks.name: British Museum
landmarks.hint: One of the world's greatest museums of human history and culture, in Bloomsbury

landmarks.name: St Paul's Cathedral
landmarks.hint: Sir Christopher Wren's masterpiece cathedral, with its famous dome on Ludgate Hill

landmarks.name: Tower Bridge
landmarks.hint: A combined bascule and suspension bridge that crosses the Thames near the Tower of London

landmarks.name: Trafalgar Square
landmarks.hint: A public square in central London commemorating the 1805 Battle of Trafalgar

landmarks.name: Hyde Park
landmarks.hint: One of the largest royal parks in London, home to the Serpentine lake and Speaker's Corner

landmarks.name: Canary Wharf
landmarks.hint: London's secondary financial district, built on a former West India Docks site in east London
